title: GeoLayers
subtitle: Interactive geospatial visualizations and maps showcasing data layers and spatial analysis.

geolayers.title: My Camino
geolayers.description: A geospatial visualization of my Camino de Santiago journey. From Florianópolis, Brazil, stepping across the Atlantic, all the way to Santiago de Compostela, Spain.

geolayers.title: Cities I Have Visited
geolayers.description: A cartographic journey through personal history. Trace the geographic footprint of travel across the globe, visualized through interactive spatial coordinates.

geolayers.title: Cities I have Lived In
geolayers.description: Mapping the places called home. A spatial narrative of the cities that have shaped my personal and professional journey across different continents.

geolayers.title: USA dropped nukes on Spain
geolayers.description: Decoding a Cold War catastrophe. An interactive reconstruction of the 1966 Palomares incident, where hydrogen bombs were accidentally dropped onto the Spanish coast.

geolayers.title: USA dropped nukes on Greenland
geolayers.description: A visualization of the 1968 Thule Air Base accident. It reconstructs the crash of a B-52 carrying hydrogen bombs in the icy landscape of Northern Greenland.

geolayers.title: Map Projection Review
geolayers.description: A Short Review on the various map projections out there, all rendered with D3.js

geolayers.title: Hiroshima-Nagasaki
geolayers.description: A spatial demonstration of the Hiroshima and Nagasaki atomic bombings, visualizing the impact zones and historical context of these events.

geolayers.title: Ecosystems of the World
geolayers.description: Get to explore the ecosystems of the world, from deserts to rainforests, and understand their unique characteristics and biodiversity.

geolayers.title: Timezones
geolayers.description: Explore the timezones of the world with this interactive map. Understand how time is divided across different regions and how it affects global connectivity.

geolayers.title: World Cities Population
geolayers.description: Explore cities around the world and their population size. This interactive map visualizes the population distribution in major cities, helping you understand urbanization patterns.

geolayers.title: Sea Level Simulator
geolayers.description: Simulate sea level rise and its impact on coastal areas. This interactive map allows users to visualize how different levels of sea rise would affect regions around the world.

geolayers.title: Solar Terminator
geolayers.description: The solar terminator shows the moving line dividing Earth's day and night sides. Watch as the shadow of our planet transitions across the globe.

geolayers.title: Brazilian Road Network
geolayers.description: A spatial visualization of the brazilian road network through OpenLayer mapping.

geolayers.title: My Favourite Restaurants in the World
geolayers.description: A culinary world map illustrating my favorite restaurants across the globe. Explore the flavors and places that have left a lasting impression.

geolayers.title: Dijkstras in Brazil
geolayers.description: Explore the optimal path between locations in Brazil using Dijkstra's algorithm. This interactive map visualizes the shortest route based on complex road network data.

geolayers.title: Berlin Wall Comparison
geolayers.description: An interactive visualization comparing the scale and geographic impact of the Berlin Wall to other cities and regions across the world.

geolayers.title: Barcelona Street Writtings
geolayers.description: Transforming the urban grid into a canvas. Write and visualize words across the streets of Barcelona, utilizing the unique geometry of the Eixample manzanas.

geolayers.title: World Tiles
geolayers.description: A masterclass in cartographic design. Explore this interactive map featuring customizable tiles that transform the visual narrative of geographic data.

geolayers.title: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
geolayers.description: A journey back to the dawn of civilization. Explore the legendary seven wonders of the ancient world, from the Great Pyramid to the Hanging Gardens.

geolayers.title: New Seven Wonders of the World
geolayers.description: Modern marvels of the human spirit. Discover the new seven wonders of the world, selected by millions to represent the pinnacle of global cultural heritage.

geolayers.title: Seven Natural Wonders of the World
geolayers.description: The raw power of the natural world. Experience the most breathtaking natural wonders on Earth, from the Grand Canyon to the Great Barrier Reef.

geolayers.title: Seven Wonders of the Modern World
geolayers.description: Triumphs of modern engineering. Explore the seven wonders of the modern world, celebrating the incredible feats of structural and civil engineering from the 20th century.

geolayers.title: Deforestation Hotspots
geolayers.description: Monitoring the planet's pulse. This map visualizes critical deforestation hotspots globally, highlighting the urgent need for environmental conservation and sustainable management.

geolayers.title: Underground Railroad Routes
geolayers.description: The path to freedom. Visualize the clandestine network of routes and safe houses used by enslaved people in the United States to escape to free states and Canada.

geolayers.title: Empires of the Past
geolayers.description: The rise and fall of civilizations. This interactive map visualizes the vast extent of historical empires, allowing users to explore their evolving boundaries and geopolitical influence.

geolayers.title: Active Volcanos
geolayers.description: Windows into the Earth's interior. Track the locations and activity of the world's most active volcanoes, and understand the tectonic forces that shape our planet.

geolayers.title: Indigenous Lands
geolayers.description: Mapping heritage and sovereignty. Explore the geographic extent of indigenous lands worldwide, highlighting the importance of territorial rights and cultural preservation.

geolayers.title: Religeous Sites
geolayers.description: Geographies of the sacred. A curated map of significant religious and spiritual sites around the globe, from ancient temples to modern cathedrals.

geolayers.title: Global Festivals
geolayers.description: A global celebration of life. Discover major festivals around the world, from the vibrant colors of Holi to the rhythmic beats of Carnival and the legendary Woodstock.

geolayers.title: Particle Accelerators
geolayers.description: Exploring the building blocks of matter. Navigate the global network of particle accelerators, including CERN and other premier research facilities pushing the frontiers of physics.

geolayers.title: Undersea Cables
geolayers.description: The nervous system of the global internet. Visualize the massive network of undersea fiber-optic cables that carry nearly all transoceanic digital traffic.

geolayers.title: Nuclear Test Sites
geolayers.description: Scars of the atomic age. Map the locations of historical nuclear test sites worldwide, reflecting on the profound impact of atomic weapons development during the 20th century.

geolayers.title: Nuclear Plants
geolayers.description: Architectures of atomic power. A global overview of nuclear power plants, exploring the distribution of nuclear energy as a major component of modern power grids.

geolayers.title: Antarctic Research Stations
geolayers.description: Outposts at the edge of the world. Navigate the diverse research stations in Antarctica, where scientists from across the globe conduct critical climate and earth science studies.

geolayers.title: UNESCO Heritage Sites
geolayers.description: The world's most precious legacy. An interactive map of UNESCO World Heritage Sites, celebrating the cultural and natural treasures that define our collective identity.

geolayers.title: Marine Traffic
geolayers.description: The global pulse of shipping. Visualize real-time and historical marine traffic patterns, revealing the complex logistics and routes that power international trade.

geolayers.title: USA Military Bases
geolayers.description: Global defense networks. A mapping of USA military bases and installations worldwide, examining the geopolitical footprint and strategic presence of the United States.
